messages:
Sam: quick FYI — during today's grooming I flagged a small batch of issues in the onboarding/runtime guide: some screenshots 403ing and one API example that doesn't match the current SDK. can folks grab what they can?
Priya: can you paste the paths? I'll take screenshots if it's just rehost work. :mag_right: 
Sam: sure — shortened list: `/docs/runtime/onboarding.md#step-3`, `/docs/runtime/auth.md` (screenshot on step 2), and `examples/python/curl_to_sdk.md` has an old `POST /v1/generate` snippet.
DocsBot: Automated link scan found 3 assets with 403 and 1 code snippet out-of-date. Report ID: RB-2026-03-20-09.
Alex: I can rehost the screenshots (have access to the image bucket). claiming `/docs/runtime/onboarding.md#step-3` and the `/docs/runtime/auth.md` screenshot. will open a tiny PR.
Jules: I'll handle the API snippet in `examples/python/curl_to_sdk.md` — quick replace with the new SDK call and run the sample. pinging @Sam for quick sanity check once PR is up.
Marta: quick question — do we prefer to rehost to the same CDN shortlink or replace with `/assets/runtime/screenshots/...` absolute path?
Sam: prefer absolute under `/assets/` for these ones (shortlinks have been flaky). thanks @Alex.
Alex: noted, will rehost to `/assets/runtime/screenshots/` and include alt text. PR name: "docs: rehost onboarding screenshots (RB-1801)".
Jules: PR for snippet will be "docs: update python example for sdk v2". dropping a link when ready.
Priya: if you want, I can run a quick preview after PR merge to confirm staging renders correctly.
Sam: awesome — timeline: Alex + Jules aim to have PRs by EOD. Priya will smoke-test on staging tomorrow morning. I'll mark these in the grooming board and add an owners note.
Alex: uploaded images and opened PR: https://git/repo/pull/4123 — small sed replace + asset add. please review when free.
Jules: opened PR: https://git/repo/pull/4124 — updated snippet and added a quick unit test for example run.
Priya: smoke tested PR-4123 on staging — screenshots render, alt text ok. PR-4124 run passes locally but staging throws a lint warning (minor). I'll push the fix to your branch @Jules unless you want to.
Jules: go ahead @Priya, thanks.
Sam: thanks all. I'll update the doc owner roster for runtime guide to reflect this. closing out here once PRs merged. :white_check_mark:
